profile.description: Active all-ages mountain community festival at Solitude Mountain Resort. The 2026 Summer Fest occurred Aug. 2 and included family activities, food and live music.

notes.subject: Active event; old Gmail response was only an auto-reply
notes.body: The December 2023 unread Gmail item was only an automatic acknowledgement and should not be treated as a real response or decline. Current official Solitude information confirms Summer Fest remained active in 2026: Aug. 2, free, all ages, with mountain/community activities, food and live music. The 2026 event is past. Verify the 2027 event and current organizer before any future outreach.

followUps.label: Check 2027 Solitude Summer Fest
followUps.reason: The event remains active and family-oriented, but we never received a meaningful response to the old outreach. Verify the 2027 date and current entertainment contact before deciding whether to pursue.
